title: How Sharing Books Makes You Less Lonely | Rebecca Toh | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】分享書籍如何讓你不再孤單？麗貝卡·託 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: A few months ago, 180 of us came together to build something in Singapore:
cues.en: A few months ago, 180 of us came together to build something in Singapore:
cues.zh: 幾個月前，我們 180 個人齊聚一堂，在新加坡打造一些東西：

cues.text: a library.
cues.en: a library.
cues.zh: 一個圖書館。

cues.text: In a city where we're lucky enough to already have a world-class, highly innovative, much beloved public library system,
cues.en: In a city where we're lucky enough to already have a world-class, highly innovative, much beloved public library system,
cues.zh: 在這座城市，我們很幸運已經擁有世界一流的、高度創新的、深受喜愛的公共圖書館系統，

cues.text: of which I am a happy beneficiary, how is our library different?
cues.en: of which I am a happy beneficiary, how is our library different?
cues.zh: 我很高興能成為其中的受益者，我們的圖書館有何不同？

cues.text: So this is a picture of the library we built.
cues.en: So this is a picture of the library we built.
cues.zh: 這是我們建造的圖書館的圖片。

cues.text: We are nestled in the heartlands of Singapore, where we sit between a 50-year-old furniture store
cues.en: We are nestled in the heartlands of Singapore, where we sit between a 50-year-old furniture store
cues.zh: 我們坐落在新加坡的中心地帶，坐落在一家擁有 50 年歷史的傢俱店之間

cues.text: and an antique shop, surrounded by birds and trees and ...
cues.en: and an antique shop, surrounded by birds and trees and ...
cues.zh: 還有一家古董店，周圍環繞著鳥類和樹木...

cues.text: Quite a few chickens.
cues.en: Quite a few chickens.
cues.zh: 好幾隻雞。

cues.text: So our library is what we call a shared library.
cues.en: So our library is what we call a shared library.
cues.zh: 所以我們的庫就是我們所說的共享庫。

cues.text: There are 180 shelves in our library, each of them rented and maintained by a different person.
cues.en: There are 180 shelves in our library, each of them rented and maintained by a different person.
cues.zh: 我們圖書館有 180 個書架，每個書架都由不同的人租用和維護。

cues.text: For 45 Singapore dollars a month you get to become a bookshelf owner.
cues.en: For 45 Singapore dollars a month you get to become a bookshelf owner.
cues.zh: 每月 45 新元，您就可以成為書架老闆。

cues.text: Being a bookshelf owner is actually really fun, because you get to share your favorite books on your own shelf,
cues.en: Being a bookshelf owner is actually really fun, because you get to share your favorite books on your own shelf,
cues.zh: 成為書架主人其實很有趣，因為你可以在自己的書架上分享你最喜歡的書，

cues.text: you get to decorate your own space and change up your books every now and then.
cues.en: you get to decorate your own space and change up your books every now and then.
cues.zh: 你可以裝飾自己的空間並時不時地更換你的書。

cues.text: Every shelf in our library is like a little pocket universe,
cues.en: Every shelf in our library is like a little pocket universe,
cues.zh: 我們圖書館的每個書架就像一個袖珍小宇宙，

cues.text: an interesting, almost voyeuristic glimpse into someone's heart and mind.
cues.en: an interesting, almost voyeuristic glimpse into someone's heart and mind.
cues.zh: 對某人的內心和思想進行有趣的、近乎偷窺的一瞥。

cues.text: And if you walk around our library, quite often you end up standing in front of a shelf
cues.en: And if you walk around our library, quite often you end up standing in front of a shelf
cues.zh: 如果你在我們的圖書館裡走來走去，你常常會站在書架前

cues.text: thinking to yourself, "I think I know this person," even though, strangely, you've never met this person in your entire life.
cues.en: thinking to yourself, "I think I know this person," even though, strangely, you've never met this person in your entire life.
cues.zh: 對自己說：“我想我認識這個人”，儘管奇怪的是，你一生中從未見過這個人。

cues.text: The other interesting thing about our library is that we are entirely volunteer-run.
cues.en: The other interesting thing about our library is that we are entirely volunteer-run.
cues.zh: 我們圖書館的另一個有趣之處是我們完全由志工經營。

cues.text: So a roster of about 40 very kind volunteer librarians
cues.en: So a roster of about 40 very kind volunteer librarians
cues.zh: 大約有 40 位非常友善的志工圖書館員

cues.text: take turns to keep our library open six days a week, 12 hours a day.
cues.en: take turns to keep our library open six days a week, 12 hours a day.
cues.zh: 我們的圖書館每週輪流開放六天，每天開放 12 小時。

cues.text: Some of them are bookshop owners, they have a shelf in our library.
cues.en: Some of them are bookshop owners, they have a shelf in our library.
cues.zh: 他們中的一些人是書店老闆，他們在我們的圖書館裡有一個書架。

cues.text: Some of them are people from the community who really want to be part of the project.
cues.en: Some of them are people from the community who really want to be part of the project.
cues.zh: 他們中的一些人來自社群，真正想成為該計畫的一部分。

cues.text: They are doctors, ex-lawyers, students, mothers, freelancers, retirees.
cues.en: They are doctors, ex-lawyers, students, mothers, freelancers, retirees.
cues.zh: 他們是醫生、前律師、學生、母親、自由工作者、退休人員。

cues.text: We even have a five-year-old librarian among us.
cues.en: We even have a five-year-old librarian among us.
cues.zh: 我們中間甚至還有一位五歲的圖書館員。

cues.text: But we all have something in common.
cues.en: But we all have something in common.
cues.zh: 但我們都有一些共同點。

cues.text: We love books, we believe in the power of books, and we enjoy being surrounded by books.
cues.en: We love books, we believe in the power of books, and we enjoy being surrounded by books.
cues.zh: 我們熱愛書籍，我們相信書籍的力量，我們喜歡被書籍包圍。

cues.text: So any time we’re open, anyone is welcome to come in, to sit down, to read a book for free,
cues.en: So any time we’re open, anyone is welcome to come in, to sit down, to read a book for free,
cues.zh: 因此，只要我們開放，任何人都歡迎進來，坐下來，免費讀書，

cues.text: to make a friend or connection, to drink a cup of coffee, randomly brewed by someone in the library,
cues.en: to make a friend or connection, to drink a cup of coffee, randomly brewed by someone in the library,
cues.zh: 結交朋友或建立聯絡，喝一杯圖書館裡某人隨機沖泡的咖啡，

cues.text: and to just let the stress of life melt off their shoulders.
cues.en: and to just let the stress of life melt off their shoulders.
cues.zh: 並讓生活的壓力從他們的肩膀上消失。

cues.text: So how did we come to build a library like this?
cues.en: So how did we come to build a library like this?
cues.zh: 那我們是如何建立這樣一個圖書館的呢？

cues.text: So in April this year, I took a break from my work as a photographer, and I went to Japan for a sabbatical,
cues.en: So in April this year, I took a break from my work as a photographer, and I went to Japan for a sabbatical,
cues.zh: 所以今年四月，我暫時放下攝影師的工作，到日本休假，

cues.text: where I stumbled upon a small, shared community library with a similar concept.
cues.en: where I stumbled upon a small, shared community library with a similar concept.
cues.zh: 在那裡我偶然發現了一個具有類似概念的小型共享社群圖書館。

cues.text: I loved it. I loved it.
cues.en: I loved it. I loved it.
cues.zh: 我喜歡它。我喜歡它。

cues.text: There was just something about the space that really enticed me.
cues.en: There was just something about the space that really enticed me.
cues.zh: 這個空間有一些東西真正吸引了我。

cues.text: Standing in that little library in Japan, even though I couldn't read any of the Japanese books,
cues.en: Standing in that little library in Japan, even though I couldn't read any of the Japanese books,
cues.zh: 站在日本那個小圖書館裡，雖然我看不懂日文的書，

cues.text: I could sense a very powerful energy of love and care.
cues.en: I could sense a very powerful energy of love and care.
cues.zh: 我能感受到一種非常強大的愛和關懷的能量。

cues.text: And even though I couldn't read any of the Japanese books there, I thought it would be wonderful if we could have
cues.en: And even though I couldn't read any of the Japanese books there, I thought it would be wonderful if we could have
cues.zh: 儘管我看不到那裡的任何日語書籍，但我想如果我們能有的話那就太好了

cues.text: something like this in Singapore.
cues.en: something like this in Singapore.
cues.zh: 新加坡也有類似的事情。

cues.text: So I decided to turn to social media.
cues.en: So I decided to turn to social media.
cues.zh: 所以我決定轉向​​社群媒體。

cues.text: So I came back to Singapore, decided to write a simple Instagram post,
cues.en: So I came back to Singapore, decided to write a simple Instagram post,
cues.zh: 所以我回到新加坡，決定寫一篇簡單的 Instagram 帖子，

cues.text: just outlining my vision of what I thought a small, shared library in Singapore could look like.
cues.en: just outlining my vision of what I thought a small, shared library in Singapore could look like.
cues.zh: 只是概述了我對新加坡小型共享圖書館的設想。

cues.text: I thought if no one responded, then I would just forget about the whole thing.
cues.en: I thought if no one responded, then I would just forget about the whole thing.
cues.zh: 我想如果沒有人回應，那麼我就會忘記整件事。

cues.text: But if I could somehow get 50 people on board, I would be happy to give this very impractical,
cues.en: But if I could somehow get 50 people on board, I would be happy to give this very impractical,
cues.zh: 但如果我能以某種方式讓 50 人加入，我會很樂意給出這個非常不切實際的，

cues.text: dreamy and idealistic idea a try.
cues.en: dreamy and idealistic idea a try.
cues.zh: 試試夢幻和理想主義的想法。

cues.text: So I quickly finished writing, pressed post, and then I went back to work.
cues.en: So I quickly finished writing, pressed post, and then I went back to work.
cues.zh: 於是我很快就寫完了，按了帖子，然後就回去工作了。

cues.text: By the end of the first day, I had received about 300 direct messages
cues.en: By the end of the first day, I had received about 300 direct messages
cues.zh: 到第一天結束時，我收到了大約 300 則私訊

cues.text: from people who said they were seriously interested in putting money down to rent a shelf
cues.en: from people who said they were seriously interested in putting money down to rent a shelf
cues.zh: 來自那些表示他們非常有興趣花錢租一個架子的人

cues.text: and to build a library together.
cues.en: and to build a library together.
cues.zh: 並共同建立一個圖書館。

cues.text: I was quite emotional that night because I could really sense people's passion
cues.en: I was quite emotional that night because I could really sense people's passion
cues.zh: 那天晚上我非常激動，因為我能真正感受到人們的熱情

cues.text: and fire in their messages.
cues.en: and fire in their messages.
cues.zh: 並在他們的資訊中火力全開。

cues.text: Living in Singapore, where, you know, life is practical and pragmatic,
cues.en: Living in Singapore, where, you know, life is practical and pragmatic,
cues.zh: 住在新加坡，你知道，那裡的生活是實際而務實的，

cues.text: this felt almost like a jailbreak kind of moment, and I think a lot of people were just waiting for the right time
cues.en: this felt almost like a jailbreak kind of moment, and I think a lot of people were just waiting for the right time
cues.zh: 這感覺就像是越獄的時刻，我想很多人只是在等待合適的時機

cues.text: and the right chance to do something like this together.
cues.en: and the right chance to do something like this together.
cues.zh: 以及一起做這樣的事情的好機會。

cues.text: I guess I was also really moved by the realization that so many people cared about books.
cues.en: I guess I was also really moved by the realization that so many people cared about books.
cues.zh: 我想我也被這麼多人關心書籍而感動。

cues.text: So I took a leap of faith.
cues.en: So I took a leap of faith.
cues.zh: 所以我有了信心的飛躍。

cues.text: I found a space to rent on the third day of the Instagram post.
cues.en: I found a space to rent on the third day of the Instagram post.
cues.zh: 在 Instagram 貼文發布的第三天，我找到了一個出租空間。

cues.text: I signed the lease on the fourth day.
cues.en: I signed the lease on the fourth day.
cues.zh: 第四天我就簽了租約。

cues.text: I'm an Aquarius, so.
cues.en: I'm an Aquarius, so.
cues.zh: 我是水瓶座，所以。

cues.text: With the help of many people, most of them strangers, we built the library in three months.
cues.en: With the help of many people, most of them strangers, we built the library in three months.
cues.zh: 在許多人（其中大多數是陌生人）的幫助下，我們在三個月內建造了圖書館。

cues.text: This is a picture of us literally building the library.
cues.en: This is a picture of us literally building the library.
cues.zh: 這是我們建造圖書館的照片。

cues.text: Here, we were installing the flooring together.
cues.en: Here, we were installing the flooring together.
cues.zh: 在這裡，我們一起安裝地板。

cues.text: So who are some of these 180 crazy people who decided to do this with me?
cues.en: So who are some of these 180 crazy people who decided to do this with me?
cues.zh: 那麼，決定和我一起做這件事的 180 個瘋狂的人中，有哪些人呢？

cues.text: So this is Raymond's shelf.
cues.en: So this is Raymond's shelf.
cues.zh: 這是雷蒙的架子。

cues.text: Raymond loves collecting CDs and books about Japan -- so these are the two things that you can find on his shelf.
cues.en: Raymond loves collecting CDs and books about Japan -- so these are the two things that you can find on his shelf.
cues.zh: 雷蒙德喜歡收集有關日本的 CD 和書籍，因此您可以在他的書架上找到這兩件東西。

cues.text: Every Tuesday, Raymond sets up a little stall outside our library
cues.en: Every Tuesday, Raymond sets up a little stall outside our library
cues.zh: 每個星期二，雷蒙德都會在我們圖書館外擺一個小攤位

cues.text: where he sells his secondhand CDs and books.
cues.en: where he sells his secondhand CDs and books.
cues.zh: 他在那裡出售二手 CD 和書籍。

cues.text: He also brews coffee -- pay as you wish -- for anyone who happens to drop by.
cues.en: He also brews coffee -- pay as you wish -- for anyone who happens to drop by.
cues.zh: 他還為任何路過的人沖泡咖啡——隨意付費。

cues.text: This is Wanqi and Liam, the mother and son.
cues.en: This is Wanqi and Liam, the mother and son.
cues.zh: 這是萬琪和利亞姆母子。

cues.text: Liam is also the five-year-old librarian I was talking about earlier.
cues.en: Liam is also the five-year-old librarian I was talking about earlier.
cues.zh: 利亞姆也是我之前提到的五歲的圖書館員。

cues.text: So far, we've been quite impressed by his work ethic.
cues.en: So far, we've been quite impressed by his work ethic.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，我們對他的職業道德印象深刻。

cues.text: And their shelf is split half-half, half between Liam's favorite children's books,
cues.en: And their shelf is split half-half, half between Liam's favorite children's books,
cues.zh: 他們的書架一半一半都是利亞姆最喜歡的兒童讀物，

cues.text: and half between Wanqi's books.
cues.en: and half between Wanqi's books.
cues.zh: 一半是萬琪的書。

cues.text: Liam was also responsible for decorating their shelf.
cues.en: Liam was also responsible for decorating their shelf.
cues.zh: 利亞姆還負責裝飾他們的架子。

cues.text: It looks great.
cues.en: It looks great.
cues.zh: 看起來很棒。

cues.text: So this particular bookshelf owner, she has decided to share some of the books
cues.en: So this particular bookshelf owner, she has decided to share some of the books
cues.zh: 所以這個特定的書架主人，她決定分享一些書

cues.text: that used to be on the shelves of Kin San, which is a Hong Kong bookshop that has unfortunately closed.
cues.en: that used to be on the shelves of Kin San, which is a Hong Kong bookshop that has unfortunately closed.
cues.zh: 這本書曾經放在香港建山書店的書架上，不幸的是，書店已經關門了。

cues.text: She has also replicated a miniature version of the banner that used to hang in front of Kin San that says "ideas are bulletproof."
cues.en: She has also replicated a miniature version of the banner that used to hang in front of Kin San that says "ideas are bulletproof."
cues.zh: 她還複製了金山前面懸掛的橫幅的微型版本，上面寫著「想法是刀槍不入的」。

cues.text: In a way, Kin San lives on right here inside our library.
cues.en: In a way, Kin San lives on right here inside our library.
cues.zh: 從某種程度上來說，金山就住在我們的圖書館裡。

cues.text: This particular bookshop owner, her name is Mira, is a preschool teacher.
cues.en: This particular bookshop owner, her name is Mira, is a preschool teacher.
cues.zh: 這位特別的書店老闆，她的名字叫米拉，是一名學前班老師。

cues.text: She believes in the power of letter writing,
cues.en: She believes in the power of letter writing,
cues.zh: 她相信寫信的力量，

cues.text: especially with children, which is why you can find a mailbox on her shelf.
cues.en: especially with children, which is why you can find a mailbox on her shelf.
cues.zh: 尤其是對於孩子來說，這就是為什麼你可以在她的架子上找到一個郵箱。

cues.text: So apart from reading the amazing selection of books on her shelf, you can also write her a letter.
cues.en: So apart from reading the amazing selection of books on her shelf, you can also write her a letter.
cues.zh: 因此，除了閱讀她書架上精選的精彩書籍外，您還可以寫一封信給她。

cues.text: She has promised that she'll definitely write you back.
cues.en: She has promised that she'll definitely write you back.
cues.zh: 她已經答應她一定會回信給你。

cues.text: So one of the most frequent questions we get asked is
cues.en: So one of the most frequent questions we get asked is
cues.zh: 所以我們最常被問到的問題之一是

cues.text: how does this library stay open?
cues.en: how does this library stay open?
cues.zh: 這個圖書館如何保持開放？

cues.text: It doesn't really make economic sense, right?
cues.en: It doesn't really make economic sense, right?
cues.zh: 這其實沒有經濟意義，對吧？

cues.text: I think the simple answer is because 180 people have decided that it is possible to come together
cues.en: I think the simple answer is because 180 people have decided that it is possible to come together
cues.zh: 我認為答案很簡單，因為 180 個人已經決定有可能走在一起

cues.text: to build a ground-up book space for the local community.
cues.en: to build a ground-up book space for the local community.
cues.zh: 為當地社群建立一個全新的圖書空間。

cues.text: And as it turns out, this is actually quite a practical solution
cues.en: And as it turns out, this is actually quite a practical solution
cues.zh: 事實證明，這實際上是一個非常實用的解決方案

cues.text: because this means that we're able to share the rent among 180 people,
cues.en: because this means that we're able to share the rent among 180 people,
cues.zh: 因為這意味著我們可以與 180 個人分攤租金，

cues.text: and no one person has to bear the financial burden
cues.en: and no one person has to bear the financial burden
cues.zh: 並且沒有人需要承擔經濟負擔

cues.text: of keeping this space open.
cues.en: of keeping this space open.
cues.zh: 保持這個空間開放。

cues.text: The other question we get asked a lot is, what do you get out of doing this?
cues.en: The other question we get asked a lot is, what do you get out of doing this?
cues.zh: 我們常被問到的另一個問題是，這樣做你能得到什麼？

cues.text: Well, we definitely don't get paid in the traditional sense, in dollars and cents.
cues.en: Well, we definitely don't get paid in the traditional sense, in dollars and cents.
cues.zh: 嗯，我們絕對不會得到傳統意義上的報酬，就是美元和美分。

cues.text: But we have been open for about four months now, and a lot of us have found the library
cues.en: But we have been open for about four months now, and a lot of us have found the library
cues.zh: 但我們已經開放了大約四個月了，我們很多人都找到了圖書館

cues.text: to be one of the rare places where we feel truly at home.
cues.en: to be one of the rare places where we feel truly at home.
cues.zh: 成為我們真正感到賓至如歸的罕見地方之一。

cues.text: On most days, our library also doubles as a community center.
cues.en: On most days, our library also doubles as a community center.
cues.zh: 大多數時候，我們的圖書館還兼作社群中心。

cues.text: So apart from the usual book clubs, women sharing circles,
cues.en: So apart from the usual book clubs, women sharing circles,
cues.zh: 所以除了常見的讀書會、女性分享圈之外，

cues.text: people have also used it to host curry night, hot pot night
cues.en: people have also used it to host curry night, hot pot night
cues.zh: 人們也用它來舉辦咖哩之夜、火鍋之夜

cues.text: for 40 people.
cues.en: for 40 people.
cues.zh: 適合 40 人。

cues.text: And also, two times a month we run a midnight library where we open till late,
cues.en: And also, two times a month we run a midnight library where we open till late,
cues.zh: 而且，我們每月兩次開設午夜圖書館，開放至深夜，

cues.text: or at least as late as the last person would like to stay.
cues.en: or at least as late as the last person would like to stay.
cues.zh: 或至少晚到最後一個人願意留下來的時間。

cues.text: I see community in every corner of our little library.
cues.en: I see community in every corner of our little library.
cues.zh: 我在我們小圖書館的每個角落都看到了社群。

cues.text: I see community in the people who bring food and drinks
cues.en: I see community in the people who bring food and drinks
cues.zh: 我在帶來食物和飲料的人們中看到了社群

cues.text: and ideas and resources to our library that they freely share with each other.
cues.en: and ideas and resources to our library that they freely share with each other.
cues.zh: 他們免費分享我們圖書館的想法和資源。

cues.text: People rush to return their library books even though we have no late fees --
cues.en: People rush to return their library books even though we have no late fees --
cues.zh: 儘管我們沒有滯納金，人們還是爭先恐後地歸還圖書館的書籍——

cues.text: I think because they can sense the love and the care that has gone into every shelf in our library,
cues.en: I think because they can sense the love and the care that has gone into every shelf in our library,
cues.zh: 我想因為他們能感受到我們圖書館每個書架上的愛與關懷，

cues.text: and also because I think they just really want to share the books
cues.en: and also because I think they just really want to share the books
cues.zh: 也因為我覺得他們真的很想分享這些書

cues.text: with other people, right?
cues.en: with other people, right?
cues.zh: 和其他人在一起，對嗎？

cues.text: They want other people to have access to the books.
cues.en: They want other people to have access to the books.
cues.zh: 他們希望其他人能夠閱讀這些書籍。

cues.text: I see community in the little children who come into our library.
cues.en: I see community in the little children who come into our library.
cues.zh: 我在來到我們圖書館的小朋友身上看到了社群。

cues.text: Little kids who actually remind each other to, you know, like, please take care of the books, don't bend the pages,
cues.en: Little kids who actually remind each other to, you know, like, please take care of the books, don't bend the pages,
cues.zh: 小朋友其實互相提醒，你知道，例如，請愛護書本，不要弄彎書頁，

cues.text: put the book back in the right place.
cues.en: put the book back in the right place.
cues.zh: 把書放回正確的地方。

cues.text: I see community in our volunteer librarians, who spend a lot of time cleaning the library, cataloging books,
cues.en: I see community in our volunteer librarians, who spend a lot of time cleaning the library, cataloging books,
cues.zh: 我在我們的志工圖書館員中看到了社群，他們花費大量時間打掃圖書館、編目書籍、

cues.text: and pouring their soul into making sure that the library is a welcoming space
cues.en: and pouring their soul into making sure that the library is a welcoming space
cues.zh: 傾盡全力確保圖書館成為一個溫馨的空間

cues.text: for everyone.
cues.en: for everyone.
cues.zh: 對於每個人。

cues.text: And because of all this, Singapore feels a little different to me these days.
cues.en: And because of all this, Singapore feels a little different to me these days.
cues.zh: 正因為如此，新加坡這些天給我的感覺有點不同。

cues.text: These days, Singapore feels a little more generous, warm, open, kind,
cues.en: These days, Singapore feels a little more generous, warm, open, kind,
cues.zh: 現今的新加坡給人的感覺更加大方、熱情、開放、友善，

cues.text: joyful and trusting.
cues.en: joyful and trusting.
cues.zh: 快樂和信任。

cues.text: In a world where people feel increasingly lonely, society feels increasingly fragmented,
cues.en: In a world where people feel increasingly lonely, society feels increasingly fragmented,
cues.zh: 在一個人們感到越來越孤獨、社會越來越支離破碎的世界裡，

cues.text: this little library has given us -- or at least it has given me -- a feeling of power.
cues.en: this little library has given us -- or at least it has given me -- a feeling of power.
cues.zh: 這個小圖書館給了我們──或至少給了我──一種力量的感覺。

cues.text: Not the kind of power that is heavy and destructive, but the kind of power that is light and regenerative.
cues.en: Not the kind of power that is heavy and destructive, but the kind of power that is light and regenerative.
cues.zh: 不是那種沉重的、破壞性的力量，而是那種輕盈的、再生性的力量。

cues.text: This little library has given me renewed hope that we do have the power to come together
cues.en: This little library has given me renewed hope that we do have the power to come together
cues.zh: 這個小圖書館給了我新的希望，我們確實有能力走在一起

cues.text: to build what we think is missing in our lives,
cues.en: to build what we think is missing in our lives,
cues.zh: 去建立我們認為生活中缺少的東西，

cues.text: in our city, in our world.
cues.en: in our city, in our world.
cues.zh: 在我們的城市，在我們的世界。

cues.text: And sometimes, that missing thing is a small, shared,
cues.en: And sometimes, that missing thing is a small, shared,
cues.zh: 有時，那個缺失的東西是一個小的、共享的、

cues.text: community-owned library.
cues.en: community-owned library.
cues.zh: 社群擁有的圖書館。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。
